_note: Transcribed from the committed examples/demo/output/report.md so the harness has a real run to score offline. That report does NOT record anchor_phrases, so they are left empty here rather than reconstructed — the anchor metric therefore reports as undefined for this fixture, which is the honest outcome. 'checker' is the literal string in the committed report; it predates the model-disclosure change, so the judging model for this run is unrecoverable.

claims.claim: Deep learning on frontal chest radiographs detected type 2 diabetes with an external validation AUC of 0.94.
claims.note: The source reports an external validation ROC AUC of 0.77 (Emory cohort), not 0.94; even the internal prospective test AUC was only 0.84.

claims.claim: Regulators are clearing AI systems for clinical imaging use at an accelerating pace.
The UK Biobank cohort profile describes recruitment of approximately 500,000 adults aged 40-69 years.
claims.note: The summary states UK Biobank recruited over 500,000 participants aged 40-69 years in 2006-2010, matching the claim's cohort size and age range.

claims.claim: The UK Biobank imaging enhancement targets 100,000 participants.
claims.note: The abstract states the imaging study aims to re-invite 100,000 participants for multi-modal imaging, and this target is repeated throughout the paper.

claims.claim: Nearly one in five confirmed participants had not attended an imaging assessment centre.
claims.note: The source says 97% of confirmed, eligible participants who booked an appointment attended an imaging assessment centre — only 3% had not yet attended, not nearly one in five. The ~29% figure in the flow chart refers to confirmed participants ineligible after pre-screen, not non-attendance.

uncited.claim: Routine imaging archives are among the largest untapped screening resources in medicine.
